name: cp-skill-health-check
tagline_zh: Commonplace 项目总在启动时莫名报错？查布局、找技能、验 uv、看 PATH，一次体检揪出藏得最深的配置。
tagline_en: Commonplace failing at launch? Check layout, skill discovery, uv install, PATH ownership—one scan finds the.
desc_en: Diagnose Commonplace project layout, promoted-skill discovery, user-level uv tool installation, command PATH ownership, and launch-environment failures.
why_zh: 同类工具只查日志，它直接验证你项目的五层健康链，连 PATH 归属和 uv 用户级安装这种盲区都不放过。
why_en: Unlike log checkers, it audits five layers of project health, including PATH ownership and uv user-level installs—blind spots.
